image_note: no curated picture source covers german, and a searched picture has to be looked at before it lands, so this deck's images come from the reviewed stage alone
audio_note: the german wiktionary carries a community recording on most entries, filtered by the De- filename prefix so a neighbouring language's audio cannot arrive; anything left over is synthesised inside anki
inflection_note: the official word list states a verb's principal parts and a noun's plural for every entry, so the forms are filled at import and the wiktionary table pass has nothing left to fetch — hence no rows are configured for it
level_note: german is the first language here with an official machine-readable level: the goethe-institut publishes one word list per level and each is cumulative, so a word's level is read from which list first holds it rather than judged by the model. this replaces the graded lexicon, which has no german resource
